line.town.greet_early.2: Morning! The sun's about to come up.
line.town.greet_early.3: You're up early. Couldn't sleep either?
line.town.greet_early.4: Good morning. So quiet, isn't it?
line.town.greet_early.5: Hello. The best time of day, while everyone's asleep.
line.town.greet_morning.2: Morning. Off to school? Or is it the holidays?
line.town.greet_morning.3: Morning! It'll be a good day, you can tell by the sky.
line.town.greet_morning.4: Good morning. Had time for breakfast?
line.town.greet_morning.5: Morning! Careful, the steps are slippery in the mornings.
line.town.greet_day.3: Hello. It's lovely by the sea today.
line.town.greet_day.4: Hi there. Not lost? There are lots of stairs here.
line.town.greet_day.5: Good afternoon. You're not from here, are you? I know everyone here.
line.town.greet_evening.2: Evening. Did you see the sunset today?
line.town.greet_evening.4: Evening. The street lamps are on, pretty, isn't it?
line.town.greet_evening_dark.1: Hello. It gets dark early now.
line.town.greet_night.3: It's late. Won't your mum be cross?
line.town.greet_night.4: It's nice here at night: just the sea and the lamps.
line.town.greet_elder_morning.2: Oh, good morning. My legs won't work in the mornings.
line.town.greet_elder_morning_cold.1: Morning! You should put a hat on, there's a wind off the sea.
line.town.greet_elder_day.2: Good afternoon. And whose boy are you?
line.town.greet_elder_day.3: Hello. Don't run like that, you'll make it.
line.town.greet_elder_evening.2: Evening. Off home with you, it's late.
line.town.greet_elder_evening.3: Evening. Did you see the sun go down today?
line.town.greet_kid.4: Look, I've got a stone with a hole! It's a lucky stone.
line.town.greet_kid.5: Mum said I can go as far as the lamp post and back.
line.town.greet_teen.2: Oh, hi. Going to the club?
line.town.greet_teen.3: Hi. Did you see there's a new game at the club?
line.town.greet_seller.1: Young man, come and have a look!
line.town.greet_seller.2: Hello! A discount, just for you.
line.town.stroll.1: I should walk more often. I promise myself every time.
line.town.stroll.2: The sea's sort of silver today.
line.town.stroll.3: How many steps are there here? They say you get a different number every time.
line.town.stroll.4: Good thing they built the promenade. It used to be all sand here.
line.town.stroll.5: The gulls are squabbling over something again.
line.town.stroll.6: Smells of seaweed. There was a storm last night, then.
line.town.night_walk.1: The town's different at night. Quieter, and more honest.
line.town.night_walk.2: There's a window lit over there. Someone else is awake.
line.town.night_walk.3: The lighthouse blinks. One, two... One, two.
line.town.night_walk.4: Sometimes I think someone repaints the sea at night.
line.town.night_walk_clear.1: The stars are low tonight. Reach out and you'd touch one.
line.town.sunrise.1: There it is. I come every morning, and every time is like the first.
line.town.sunrise.2: Warm. Feel it? It's warming already.
line.town.sunrise.3: They say whoever greets the sun will never lose it.
line.town.sunrise.4: One more minute. The best bit's coming.
line.town.sunset.1: Look how it's setting. As if it doesn't want to.
line.town.sunset.2: I come here every evening. I don't know why. I just have to.
line.town.sunset.3: It'll be windy tomorrow. See how red it is.
line.town.sunset.4: If only it wouldn't set. Just once.
line.town.sea.1: Look at the horizon long enough and it seems to come closer.
line.town.sea.2: The train's going over the water. Every time I can't believe it doesn't sink.
line.town.sea.3: I'm looking for amber. You find it after a storm.
line.town.sea_summer.1: The water's cold. I'm going in anyway.
line.town.sea_fog.1: The island's out there somewhere. You can't see it in the fog.
line.town.fish.2: Yesterday one this big was biting here. Don't believe me? Suit yourself.
line.town.fish_herring.1: Now's the time for Baltic herring.
line.town.fish_sun.1: The sun on the water's in the fishes' eyes. I'll wait for a cloud.
line.town.bench.1: I'll sit for a minute. My legs are buzzing.
line.town.bench.2: It's nice here. You can do nothing at all.
line.town.bench.3: The pigeons are waiting again. I've got nothing, nothing.
line.town.bench_sun.1: The sun's warm. My eyes are closing by themselves.
line.town.kid_play.5: It's not sand, it's gold. I'm digging it up.
line.town.kid_play.6: Let's see who can jump furthest!
line.town.kid_sun.1: Where does the sun go at night?
line.town.kid_sun.2: I'll draw the sun some eyes. So it can look at us.
line.town.pupil.2: We've got an essay to write about the sun. Weird topic, right?
line.town.pupil.4: The PE teacher said to run to the lighthouse. The lighthouse!
line.town.student.2: I'm reading about stars. Turns out the sun's a star too. An ordinary one. Kind of hurtful.
line.town.student.3: There's a film at the culture house tonight. Something old, they say.
line.town.student.1: Exams soon. And I'm on the beach. Makes sense.
line.town.commuter_evening.1: All day over there, in the city. And here there's the sea.
line.town.commuter_evening.3: Sometimes I'm on the train and wonder what's past the last station.
line.town.homemaker.1: Buy bread, buy milk... There was something else.
line.town.homemaker_day.1: While everyone's at work, the town's mine.
line.town.homemaker_damp.1: The washing won't dry in this damp.
line.town.unemployed.1: I'm looking for work. Or maybe it's looking for me.
line.town.unemployed.2: Nowhere to hurry to. That's a skill too.
line.town.writer.1: I've got the first sentence. Three hundred pages to go.
line.town.writer.2: Everything you see will be a book one day.
line.town.writer.3: Everyone here has a story. You just have to ask.
line.town.artist.1: Light like this lasts ten minutes a day. Got to catch it.
line.town.artist.2: You can't paint the sea. You can only try.
line.town.artist.3: I'm out of ultramarine. I'll have to paint the sunset.
line.town.musician.2: Even the gulls here cry in key. A minor.
line.town.musician_day.1: We're playing on the promenade tonight. Come along.
line.town.programmer.1: It works. I don't know why, but it works. I'm not touching it.
line.town.programmer.2: Sometimes it feels like someone wrote this town. It's all too neat.
line.town.programmer.3: The laptop stayed at home. So today's a day off.
line.town.fisherman.2: Wind from the west: we're not going out tomorrow.
line.town.fisherman.3: You can't fool the sea. It sees everything.
line.town.fisherman.1: At sea since four this morning. Now I can sit on the shore a bit.
line.town.owl.1: The best time is when everyone's asleep. Well, almost everyone.
line.town.owl.2: I won't get up in the morning. Oh well.
line.town.owl.3: Nights are for thinking. Days are for living.
line.town.lark.1: The sun smiles first at those who get up early.
line.town.lark.2: Five in the morning and the coffee's already gone.
line.town.hungry.1: I'm starving... Pelmeni would be nice.
line.town.hungry.2: Somebody's frying fish somewhere. My stomach heard it at once.
line.town.tired.1: My eyes are closing. Home to bed.
line.town.tired_bench.1: A bit longer and I'll fall asleep right here on the bench.
line.town.sun_day.1: Oh, it's so warm. I can feel the sun warming my skin.
line.town.sun_day.2: I'll stand in the sun a minute. Recharge a bit.
line.town.sun_day.3: Don't look straight at it. Just know it's there.
line.town.sun_october.1: October, and it's still warm. As if it's just for us.
line.town.sun_cloudy.1: Oh, it's a shame there's no sun now. It's gone behind the clouds.
line.town.sun_cloudy.2: When it's grey for a long time, I feel like everything around gets thinner.
line.town.sun_cloudy.3: It'll come out. It always does.
line.town.sun_low.1: The sun's going down. I must catch it.
line.town.sun_night.1: The sun's on the other side somewhere now. Shining for someone.
line.town.sun_night.2: Dawn's a long way off. Never mind, we'll wait.
line.town.rain.1: Rain again. Good for the flowers, at least.
line.town.rain.2: The umbrella's at home, of course.
line.town.rain.3: In the rain the sea smells stronger.
line.town.snow.1: The snow's creaking. Means it's frosty.
line.town.snow.2: The terraces under snow look like a cake.
line.town.fog.1: Fog so thick the lighthouse cuts it like a knife.
line.town.fog.2: In the fog every sound is close by.
line.town.cold.1: Brr... I could do with a warmer scarf.
line.town.cold.2: My nose is freezing. Winter's coming.
line.town.warm.1: It's hot! Everyone to the beach!
line.town.warm.2: The sun's so lovely you want to say thank you to it.
line.town.seller.1: Come on over, don't be shy!
line.town.seller.3: Young man, something fresh? It's just come in.
line.town.seller_morning.1: It's only morning and half the stall's gone already.
line.town.seller_late.1: It's the last of it, I'll let it go for half price.
line.town.fishmonger.4: You choose fish by the eyes. Clear eyes: take it.
line.town.butcher.2: For cutlets? For soup? Tell me, I'll pick you something.
line.town.butcher.3: The cleaver needs sharpening. It needed it yesterday.
line.town.vendor.2: Hot pies! With cabbage, with egg!
line.town.vendor_cold.1: Tea from the samovar! Warm yourselves up!
line.town.carousel.2: Hold on tight, off we go!
line.town.carousel_old.1: Twenty years I've been turning it, and my head doesn't spin.
line.town.lifeguard.1: I see everything. That's the job.
line.town.lifeguard_summer.2: The water's sixteen degrees today. For the Baltic, that's a resort.
line.town.lifeguard_off.1: Off season. I sit and watch the waves.
line.town.keeper.1: A lighthouse is just a light that doesn't sleep.
line.town.keeper.2: Someone was signalling from the sea again last night. Three short.
line.town.keeper.3: I must wipe the glass. The salt settles on it.
line.town.janitor.2: Who's stuck gum on the step again?
line.town.janitor_autumn.1: Leaves, leaves... In autumn a broom's your best friend.
line.town.guard.2: I was on the night shift. Now if only I could sleep.
line.town.teacher.2: The hardest thing at school is the bell. Especially the last one.
line.town.teacher.1: Why aren't you at school? Oh, it's a day off...
line.town.teacher_sun.1: Thirty exercise books to mark. And look at that sun.
line.town.doctor.1: Walk more and sleep more. I don't know a better prescription.
line.town.doctor.2: The sun's the best doctor. Only you can't prescribe it.
line.town.doctor_cold.1: Put a scarf on, it's draughty.
line.town.librarian.2: All the books in the library smell of the sea. Don't ask why.
line.town.librarian.1: Don't forget to bring the book back. Two weeks.
line.town.barista.2: Everyone drinks cappuccino. If only someone would ask for something strange.
line.town.barista.3: I draw a heart or a little sun in the foam. People ask for the sun more.
line.town.barista.1: Two hundred cups today. My hands still smell of coffee.
line.town.cashier.1: Beep, beep, beep... I dream about it at night.
line.town.cashier.2: Need a bag? Oh, I'm not at work. Habit.
line.town.coach.1: A morning run to the lighthouse and back. Who's with me?
line.town.dance.1: One-two-three, one-two-three... A waltz is just walking beautifully.
line.town.dance.2: Dancing at the culture house on Saturday. Come, I'll teach you.
line.town.choir.1: Choir in the hall in the evenings. We need voices, men's especially.
line.town.choir.2: When you sing in a choir, even the sea joins in.
line.town.projectionist.1: We're showing an old film tonight. The reel rustles like the surf.
line.town.projectionist.2: The main thing in a cinema is the dark. And someone next to you.
line.town.clerk_off.1: The report's in. The report's in! I can live again.
line.town.clerk_off.2: Stamp, signature, another stamp. The town runs on paper.
line.town.receptionist.1: New arrivals at the sanatorium. Forty people, and they all want a sea view.
line.town.receptionist.2: "Welcome." I say it even in my sleep.
line.town.manager.1: Deliveries, rotas, complaints. And I'd just like to have lunch.
line.town.manager.2: If everyone's happy, something's been missed.
line.town.director.1: A letter came from above: the children are to spend more time in the sun. A strange letter.
line.town.director.2: They promised to fix the gym by summer. Which summer, they didn't say.
line.town.master.1: Everything can be fixed. Except time.
line.town.master.2: Someone brought me a clock that runs backwards. I said: that's how it's meant to be.
line.town.cook_off.1: All day at the stove, and at home a sandwich. Classic.
line.town.cook_off.2: Have you tried our fish soup? No? That hurts. Come by.
line.town.waiter_off.1: My feet are buzzing. Full house today.
line.town.waiter_off.2: The politest person in the world is a waiter after a shift. They say nothing at all.
line.town.seller_off.1: Shouting "come over" all day, by evening you've no voice left.
line.town.granny.1: In our day nobody sat about on the stairs.
line.town.granny.2: Milk's gone up again. I'll be getting a cow soon.
line.town.granny.3: Pigeons, pigeons... I've no bread left, I gave it all away.
line.town.granny.4: That one with the little dog's in a new coat again.
line.town.granny.5: I've lived in this building forty years. Or fifty. It's all the same.
line.town.granny.6: My grandson promised to ring. He will, he will.
line.town.granny.7: Such beauty. And new every day.
line.town.granny.8: Sitting's work too. Someone's got to keep an eye on everything.
line.town.granny_cold.1: Young people with no hats again. They'll catch their death.
line.town.granny_sun.1: Sunshine... I'll sit and warm myself while it shines.
line.town.granny_knees.1: Oh, my knees... Rain's on the way.
line.town.granny_about_hero.1: Whose boy is that? Not one of ours, I think.
line.town.granny_about_hero.2: A nice boy. Quiet. A bit thin, though.
line.town.granny_hero.1: Son, have you eaten today? You're so thin.
line.town.granny_hero.2: Come here, I'll give you a sweet.
line.town.granny_hero.3: Whose boy are you? Which building?
line.town.granny_hero.4: Don't run on the steps, you'll hurt yourself.
line.town.granny_hero.5: Ah, youth... Off you go and play while there's sun.
line.town.granny_talk1.1: Did you see they've opened a restaurant? Yantar.
line.town.granny_talk1.3: They say the borscht's like mum's.
line.town.granny_talk2.2: Up and down. It's the weather.
line.town.granny_talk2.3: Mine too. It's all the weather.
line.town.granny_talk3.1: They say the train to the island runs right over the water.
line.town.granny_talk3.3: And I still haven't got round to going.
line.town.granny_talk6.1: That lot were at their computers all night again.
line.town.granny_talk6.3: We were up all night too. At the dances.
line.town.granny_talk8.1: Remember when it was sand all the way to the sea here?
line.town.granny_talk8.4: I don't remember them ever not being there.
line.town.granny_talk9.1: Did you see a gull snatch a pie off a boy this morning?
line.town.granny_talk11.1: They're getting the choir together at the culture house again.
line.town.granny_talk11.3: My voice isn't what it was.
line.town.granny_talk12.1: Someone was singing on the promenade again last night.
line.town.granny_talk12.4: One doesn't rule out the other.
line.town.granny_talk5.2: Warm. Like when we were little.
line.town.granny_talk5.3: It's always like when we were little. We're the ones who've changed.
line.town.granny_talk10.3: Last year at this time we were swimming.
line.town.granny_talk10.4: You were swimming. I was watching.
line.town.grandpa.1: Chess, anyone? Nobody. Fine, I'll play myself.
line.town.grandpa.2: When I was young I pulled fish this big off the pier. Now that was fish!
line.town.grandpa.3: A newspaper would be nice. Though what's new...
line.town.grandpa.4: Wind off the sea. The weather's turning.
line.town.grandpa.5: In my day we went dancing. Now it's the club and the computers.
line.town.grandpa_talk1.3: You've been thinking for twenty minutes.
line.town.grandpa_talk1.4: Chess doesn't like to be rushed.
line.town.grandpa_talk2.1: The fish used to jump onto the shore by themselves.
line.town.grandpa_talk2.2: We used to jump about too.
line.town.grandpa_talk3.1: Seen the new restaurant? Glass all round.
line.town.grandpa_talk3.2: I've seen it. Like an aquarium.
line.town.grandpa_talk3.3: Only we're not the fish in there.
line.town.grandpa_talk3.4: Depends how you look at it.
line.town.grandpa_talk4.2: It feels the weather better than the forecasters.
line.town.grandpa_talk5.2: It's autumn. It turns its side to us.
line.town.grandpa_talk5.3: Never mind. In spring it'll turn its face to us again.
line.town.gamer.2: One more match and I'm going home.
line.town.gamer.6: You can't beat this level. Someone made it like that on purpose.
line.town.gamer.7: Quiet, I've got headphones on but I can hear everything.
line.town.gamer.8: I could do with a soda... Somebody buy me a Baikal.
line.town.gamer.9: My eyes are closing. It's not me falling asleep, it's my character.
line.town.gamer.11: Play long enough and it feels like the game is playing you.
line.town.gamer.12: Boss, can I have another hour?
line.town.gamer_kid.1: Mum's calling. Can't hear, can't hear...
line.town.gamer_adult.2: In my day we never dreamt of hardware like this.
line.town.gamer_morning.1: It's morning already? How is it morning already?
line.town.gamer_snack.1: The machine didn't give me change again.
line.town.gamer_snack.2: Crisps and a Tarragon. The champion's dinner.
line.town.gamer_talk1.4: Oh, in the game: also to your left.
line.town.gamer_talk3.1: How much time have you got left?
line.town.gamer_talk4.1: See that? How I got him?
line.town.gamer_talk4.2: I saw. It was a fluke.
line.town.gamer_talk6.3: Any. It's not for my phone, it's for my soul.
line.town.gamer_talk7.1: Are you going to school tomorrow?
line.town.gamer_talk7.3: No idea. That's why I'm asking.
line.town.gamer_talk8.1: Shall we go and watch the sunset?
line.town.waiter_sit.1: Hello! The menu's on the table, I'll be right with you.
line.town.waiter_sit.2: Welcome to Yantar. Bread and water are on the house.
line.town.waiter_sit.3: A good table. You get the best view of the sunset from here.
line.town.waiter_sit_evening.1: Good evening! Have a look at the menu, there's a dish of the day.
line.town.waiter_sit_festival.1: Happy holiday! There are festival dishes on the menu today.
line.town.waiter_carry.3: One moment, I'm on my way.
line.town.waiter_serve.4: Here you are. The cook asked me to say: eat while the sun's still up.
line.town.waiter_bill.1: Your bill. It's all paid already.
line.town.waiter_bill.2: Leaving already? I hope you enjoyed everything.
line.town.waiter_bill.3: Here you are. Come back for the dish of the day, it's new every day.
line.town.waiter_bye.2: Goodbye! There'll be a new dish of the day tomorrow.
line.town.waiter_bye.3: All the best. Mind the steps.
line.town.waiter_work.2: Everyone wants the fish soup today. As if they'd agreed.
line.town.cook.5: We've been making pelmeni since morning. Each one like a little sun.
line.town.cook.6: The dish of the day came out well. I won't say which, you'll see.
line.town.guest.1: The borscht's like mum's. Even better, just don't tell her.
line.town.guest.2: This is the best sea view in the whole town.
line.town.guest.3: Could we have some more bread?
line.town.guest.4: I only come here for the medovik.
line.town.guest.5: Good thing we sat by the window. It's like having lunch in the sky.
line.town.guest.6: It smells of dill and the sea. The best smell.
line.town.guest.7: The bill, please. Oh, you pay as you order here.
line.town.guest_sunset.1: The coffee's gone cold. The sunset was worth it.
line.town.guest_special.mon: Monday is solyanka day. It's the law.
line.town.guest_special.thu: Fish Thursday. The flounder's so fresh it might have walked here from the pier.
line.town.guest_special.fri: Friday, shashlik... The week wasn't wasted.
line.town.guest_special.sat: Sushi by the sea. Almost like Japan, they say.
line.town.guest_special.sun: Blini with caviar on a Sunday. It's not a restaurant, it's a holiday.
line.town.guest_festival.1: Festival fish soup! They only make it on holidays.
line.town.guest_festival.2: Hot sbiten with honey. The holiday's right inside you.
line.town.guest_talk5.2: I don't remember. Seems like there was always a restaurant.
line.town.guest_talk6.2: Let's. The service was lovely today.
line.town.guest_talk2.1: Look, the sun's right in your glass.
line.town.guest_talk4.3: We're on a diet from Monday.
line.town.fest_greet.2: Happy holiday! Don't miss the best bit tonight.
line.town.fest_greet_kid.1: It's a holiday today! Did you know?
line.town.fest_any.1: The whole town's outside. I love it like this.
line.town.fest_any.2: On a holiday even the sea looks dressed up.
line.town.fest_any.3: They've hung the bunting, so it'll be fun.
line.town.fest_fair.1: Everything here's so tasty there won't be enough money.
line.town.fest_fair.2: The carousel's running! Shall we go?
line.town.fest_fair.3: Don't get lost in the crowd!
line.town.fest_watch.2: I can't see a thing! Let me through to the front.
line.town.fest_concert.1: They sing well. Especially when they hit the notes.
line.town.fest_concert.2: They've put the stage right by the sea. The music floats over the water.
line.town.fest_fireworks.4: It's reflected in the water. Two fireworks at once.
line.town.fest_dance.1: Everyone's dancing! Even those who can't.
line.town.fest_dance.2: I'm not dancing. I'm just sort of moving.
line.town.fest_bonfire.1: The fire's as warm as the sun. Only closer.
line.town.fest_bonfire.2: The sparks are flying right up to the stars.
line.town.fest_firecrackers.2: Firecrackers chase away everything bad. Loudly.
line.town.fest_market.1: Saturday means the market. Without the market, Saturday isn't Saturday.
line.town.fest_market.2: I'm off for some cottage cheese before it's all gone.
line.town.fest_market.3: That old man with the honey's at the market again. The best honey.
line.town.fest_sea.1: The Sea Festival! The most important day of the year.
line.town.fest_sea.2: They say the sea is kinder on this day.
line.town.fest_sea.3: They've made enough fish soup for the whole town.
line.town.fest_sea_before.1: Fireworks over the pier tonight. Get a spot early.
line.town.fest_lantern.1: Make a wish on your lantern and let it go. Just don't tell anyone.
line.town.fest_lantern_sky.1: So many lights... As if the stars are going home.
line.town.fest_lantern_sky.2: Mine's that one. No, that one. I can't tell any more.
line.town.fest_snow.2: The tea at the stalls is hot, but your fingers still freeze.
line.town.fest_snow.3: A snowball right down my collar! Who threw that?
line.town.fest_winter_fair.1: The winter fair means New Year's coming.
line.town.fest_winter_fair.2: Mulled wine, gingerbread, fairy lights... We'll make it to spring.
line.town.fest_new_year_eve.2: The tree on the square is the tallest in forty years.
line.town.fest_new_year.2: A new year, and the sea's the same. That's good.
line.town.fest_new_year_hero.1: Made your wish? You've got to get it in at midnight.
line.town.fest_maslenitsa.1: Blini! Who's had how many? I'm on my sixth.
line.town.fest_maslenitsa.2: A blin is a little sun. That's why they bake them.
line.town.fest_maslenitsa.3: Winter, go away! Sun, come back!
line.town.fest_maslenitsa_fire.1: I feel a bit sorry for the effigy. But not for the winter.
line.town.fest_birds.1: We've put up the nest box. Now we wait for the tenants.
line.town.fest_birds.2: The starlings are back! Hear them?
line.town.fest_blossom.1: Under the blossom even tea tastes sweeter.
line.town.fest_blossom.2: Petals in your hair. Don't brush them off, it's pretty.
line.town.fest_midsummer.1: The shortest night. Sleeping would be a crime.
line.town.fest_midsummer.2: Let's wait for the sun. Tonight it'll rise almost straight away.
line.town.fest_midsummer_hero.1: Will you jump over the fire? For luck.
line.town.fest_fisherman.1: Fisherman's Day! Today every fisherman's a hero.
line.town.fest_fisherman.2: The biggest fish hasn't been caught yet. It's waiting for us.
line.town.fest_perseids.2: Did you get your wish in?
line.town.fest_perseids.3: Lie down and watch. The sky will show you.
line.town.fest_harvest.1: The pumpkins this year are this big!
line.town.fest_harvest.2: Let's buy apples for the whole winter. And jam.
line.town.fest_lunar.2: Red is the colour of luck. Wear something red.
line.town.fest_lunar.3: The whole family makes dumplings. One has a coin in it.
line.town.fest_drums.1: The drums are beating right inside my chest.
line.town.fest_holi.1: Holi! Mind your jacket! Though it's too late now.
line.town.fest_holi.2: Everyone's every colour today. Even the gulls.
line.town.fest_holi.3: The pink will stay in my hair for a week. Let it.
line.town.fest_nowruz.1: Nowruz is the spring New Year. Day and night are equal.
line.town.fest_nowruz.2: See the sprouted wheat? That's sabzeh. For luck.
line.town.fest_children.1: Today's our day! Free ice cream! Well, nearly.
line.town.fest_children.2: I got a balloon! A blue one!
line.town.fest_children_adult.1: Today the children are in charge. As always, really.
line.town.fest_tanabata.1: What should I write on the paper? So it comes true?
line.town.fest_tanabata.2: The weaver and the herdsman meet once a year. Today.
line.town.fest_tanabata.3: If only there are no clouds. Otherwise they won't meet.
line.town.fest_toro.1: A lantern on the water is for those who've gone. So they find the way.
line.town.fest_toro.2: Look how far they've drifted. The sea looks after them.
line.town.fest_mid_autumn.1: The moon's the roundest of the year tonight.
line.town.fest_halloween.1: This isn't a mask. Kidding. Or am I.
line.town.fest_halloween_kid.2: We carved the pumpkin ourselves! Well, Dad helped.
line.town.fest_muertos.1: Marigolds are so those who've gone can find their way home.
line.town.fest_muertos.2: Today we remember. So they're close.
line.town.fest_diwali.1: Happy Diwali! May the light win.
line.town.fest_diwali.2: Every little flame stands against the dark. Light yours too.
line.town.fest_loy.1: A little boat of leaves, a candle, a flower, and you let all the bad things go.
line.town.fest_loy.2: A full moon and candles on the water. It doesn't get prettier.
line.town.fest_christmas.2: Candles in the windows, so a traveller finds the way.
line.town.fest_christmas_carols.1: Carols on the square at five. My voice is so-so, but I'm going.
line.town.fest_talk2.3: You say that about every one.
line.town.fest_talk3.3: It sounds like it's coming from the sea.
line.town.fest_talk1.1: Are you going to the fireworks?
line.town.fest_talk1.3: Me too. See you at the pier.
line.town.chat1.1: The island train came in on the dot again.
line.town.chat2.2: Like the sea: tide in, tide out.
line.town.chat3.1: The club was lit up till morning again.
line.town.chat5.4: Just to see how it's doing.
line.town.chat6.1: Seen the prices at the market?
line.town.chat7.1: I had a dream: as if we were all in somebody's book.
line.town.chat7.3: I don't know. They didn't read any further.
line.town.chat10.1: Are we going to the island tomorrow?
line.town.chat12.3: Or they just have something to say.
line.town.chat8.1: The sun took a long time to set today.
line.town.chat9.1: Have you seen the new boy?
line.town.chat9.2: The one who goes to the club?
line.town.chat11.2: I dreamt of the sun. Really close.
line.town.chat14.2: Let it. No umbrella, but I'm in a good mood.
line.town.chat15.1: Want to go to the club?
line.town.chat16.1: Someone was standing on the lighthouse last night. Right at the top.
line.town.chat_kids1.1: Let's play the floor is lava!
line.town.chat_kids2.1: Do you know why the sea's salty?
line.town.chat_kids2.3: I don't know. I'm asking you.
line.town.manner_smoke.1: The last one. Honestly, the last one.
line.town.manner_smoke.2: I'm quitting on Monday. Which Monday, I never said.
line.town.manner_smoke.3: Wind off the sea. That's my third match.
line.town.manner_smoke.4: Don't look, don't copy me. It's a bad habit.
line.town.manner_call.1: Hello! Yes, I can hear you. No, that's the gulls.
line.town.manner_call.2: Yes, yes, I'll get bread. And milk. I remember!
line.town.manner_call.3: I'm on the promenade. The pro-me-nade! The signal here...
line.town.manner_call.4: Mum, I'll call you back. Yes, I've eaten. Yes, I've got my hat on.
line.town.manner_call.5: Hang on, the cable car's humming, I can't hear a thing.
line.town.manner_scroll.1: They promised sun. Where's the sun?
line.town.manner_scroll.2: The signal's gone again. Oh well, I'll look at the sea.
line.town.manner_scroll.3: Right, the train to the island is at... oh, it's gone.
line.town.manner_feed.1: Eat up, eat up. No fighting, there's enough for everyone.
line.town.manner_feed.2: That one, with the limp, comes every day. I crumble his separately.
line.town.manner_feed.3: I don't feed the gulls. The gulls help themselves.
line.town.manner_feed.4: Quiet, don't scare them. They've only just gathered.
line.town.manner_umbrella.1: Good thing I brought the umbrella. I just had a feeling.
line.town.manner_umbrella.2: This umbrella has lived through three storms. It'll live through this drizzle.
line.town.manner_umbrella.3: Why haven't you got an umbrella? Come under mine while we walk.
line.town.manner_wet.1: Of course! Today of all days, no umbrella.
line.town.manner_wet.2: I'll run to the door, and then tea. Tea straight away.
line.town.manner_wet.3: Never mind, we're not made of sugar.
line.town.manner_cold.1: Brr, it gets into your bones. The gloves are at home, of course.
line.town.manner_cold.2: There's a draught off the sea. It'll be colder by evening.
line.town.manner_cold.3: I could do with tea from the machine now. Hot.
line.town.manner_yawn.1: Oh, excuse me. I went to bed at two last night.
line.town.manner_yawn.2: The sea rocks you to sleep even when you only look at it.
line.town.manner_yawn.3: I've sat too long. I should walk a bit.
line.town.manner_watch.2: Seven minutes left. I'll make it.
line.town.manner_watch.3: The watch is fast again. Or am I the one running slow?
line.town.manner_photo.1: Hold still, sea... That's it. Got it.
line.town.manner_photo.2: The hundredth shot of this sunset. And it's still not right.
line.town.manner_photo.3: The light's good now. It'll stay like this for ten minutes more.
line.town.manner_knit.1: Knit two, purl two... Don't put me off.
line.town.manner_knit.2: I'll finish it by winter. Some winter or other.
line.town.manner_knit.3: A scarf for my grandson. He doesn't wear them, and I knit them.
line.town.manner_paper.1: They say winter will come early. They say so every year.
line.town.manner_paper.2: Crossword: "the star everything turns around", three letters.
line.town.manner_paper.3: Not a line about our town again. And thank goodness.
line.town.manner_ice.1: It melts faster than I can eat it.
line.town.manner_ice.2: Plain ice cream, like when I was a kid. Only the cone's got smaller.
line.town.manner_ice.3: Gull, don't even think about it.
line.town.manner_drink.2: From a machine, and it's good. I don't know how they do it.
line.town.manner_sky.1: The clouds are moving fast today. There's wind up high.
line.town.manner_sky.2: Swifts flying high means fair weather.
line.town.manner_sky.3: Look, the cable car against the sky. Like beads on a string.
line.town.manner_shade.1: The sun's right in my eyes. But what a sun!
line.town.manner_shade.2: I can't see a thing, only gold.
line.town.manner_bag.1: I went for bread and I'm carrying a full bag. How does that happen?
line.town.manner_bag.2: There's fresh fish at the Gastronom today. I took two.
line.town.manner_bag.3: These stairs... Especially with a bag.
line.town.manner_doze.1: Mm?.. I'm not asleep. I'm listening to the sea.
line.town.notice_runs.1: Where are you flying to? Mind the steps!
line.town.notice_runs.2: Oh! You gave me a fright.
line.town.notice_runs.5: Late for something? Run along, then.
line.town.notice_runs_kid.1: Hey, where are you going? Did something happen?
line.town.notice_runs_kid.2: Whoa, that's fast! Want to race?
line.town.notice_close.3: There's plenty of room here, lad.
line.town.notice_close.4: What is it? Have I got something on my face?
line.town.notice_close_kid.2: Why are you standing so close?
line.town.notice_close_kid.3: Are you new? I haven't seen you before.
line.town.notice_lamp.1: Hey, the lamp! You're shining it right in my eyes.
line.town.notice_lamp.3: Oh! I thought the cable car was coming at me.
line.town.notice_lamp.4: That's some searchlight. Won't they take you for the lighthouse?
line.town.notice_sneaks.1: Oh! What are you creeping up on me for?
line.town.notice_sneaks.2: I can hear everything, you know.
line.town.notice_sneaks.3: Good heavens! You'll give someone a heart attack.
line.town.notice_sneaks.4: Playing scouts? Well, you've found me.
line.town.notice_sneaks_kid.2: Is that how you stalk birds? Teach me!
line.town.notice_rides.3: Slow down on the slope, spare your brakes.
line.town.notice_rides.4: Nice bike. Just don't break your neck.
line.town.notice_rides_kid.1: Wow! Can I have a go?
line.town.notice_rides_kid.2: Can you do it with no hands?
line.town.greet_seen.2: I think we've met before. Good day!
line.town.greet_seen.3: Out walking again? Quite right, the weather calls for it.
line.town.greet_known.1: Oh, my young friend! How are things?
line.town.greet_known.2: Hi! The promenade isn't the same without you.
line.town.greet_known.3: Hello, hello. Seen many birds today?
line.town.greet_known.4: There you are. I was just thinking I hadn't seen you about.
line.town.greet_known.5: Hi, neighbour! You're nearly a local by now.
line.town.greet_known.6: Hello! Drop in for tea some time.
line.town.greet_known_kid.1: Oh, hi! Where are you off to today?
line.town.greet_known_kid.3: It's you again! I saw you by the sea yesterday.
line.town.sky_aurora.1: Look, look, it's started! Green, right over the sea.
line.town.sky_aurora.2: The lights. All these years, and I still stand here with my mouth open.
line.town.sky_aurora.3: Hush. They say if you keep quiet, you can hear it.
line.town.sky_aurora.4: See how the folds move. As if someone were straightening a curtain.
line.town.sky_aurora.5: Don't go yet. The brightest part always comes at the end.
line.town.sky_aurora.6: I should wake my lot. No, I'll stand here one more minute.
line.town.sky_aurora_kid.1: Whoa! It's moving! Do you see? It's moving!
line.town.sky_aurora_kid.2: Could you touch it if you climbed onto the roof?
line.town.sky_aurora_kid.3: I made a wish. No, I'm not telling.
line.town.sky_rainbow.1: A rainbow! There, from the pier right over to the island.
line.town.sky_rainbow.2: There now. It was worth getting soaked for this.
line.town.sky_rainbow.3: A double one, look. The second is paler, a bit higher.
line.town.sky_rainbow.4: Hold on, don't stand in the way. Let me look my fill, it won't last.
line.town.sky_rainbow_kid.1: A rainbow! Come on, there's treasure where it ends!
line.town.sky_rainbow_kid.2: One, two, three... seven! All seven, I counted!
line.town.sky_fireworks.1: Ooooh! That one, the gold one, that's my favourite.
line.town.sky_fireworks.2: The same every year. And every year I come.
line.town.sky_fireworks.3: Watch the water. It's even lovelier in the water.
line.town.sky_fireworks.4: A big one's coming. Mind your ears!
line.town.sky_fireworks.5: Poor dog, he's at home under the bed.
line.town.sky_fireworks_kid.1: More! More! Can we have one more?
line.town.sky_fireworks_kid.2: The red one! No, the green! No, both!
line.town.outing.1: At weekends we're always here, the whole family. It's how we do things.
line.town.outing.2: All week it's each to their own. Today we're together.
line.town.outing.3: First they all grumble it's too early. Then you can't get them home.
line.town.outing.4: We've been coming here so many years the place knows us by now.
line.town.outing.5: My lot are around here somewhere. They never stray far, I've checked.
line.town.outing.6: A good day. Everyone's home, everyone's near, nowhere to be.
line.town.outing_kid.1: We come here every weekend. It's called a tradition.
line.town.outing_kid.2: We're all here today, the whole family. Even left the phones at home. Nearly all of them.
line.town.outing_kid.3: And ice cream after. I was promised. In front of witnesses!
line.town.mind_child.1: No further than the fountain! Do you hear? No further!
line.town.mind_child.2: Five more minutes. This is the third "five more minutes".
line.town.mind_child.3: Where do they get the energy? I'd settle for half.
line.town.mind_child.4: I stand, I watch. The calmest part of my day, to be honest.
line.town.mind_child.5: Hat! Put your hat on! ...There, can't hear me again.
line.town.mind_child.6: Green knees again, of course. Grass doesn't wash out.
line.town.mind_child_hero.1: Those are mine tearing about over there. Careful: they never look where they're going.
line.town.notice_fishes.2: What are you using? They won't take bread here, I've tried.
line.town.notice_fishes.3: Cast further left. There's a hole there, that's where they sit.
line.town.notice_fishes.4: Hush, hush, I'm not in the way. I'll just watch.
line.town.notice_fishes.5: Let the small ones go. Let them grow till next time.
line.town.notice_fishes_kid.1: Can I hold the rod? Just for a bit!
line.town.notice_fishes_kid.2: What if you catch a shark? You never know!
line.town.notice_swims.2: Don't swim out far! There's a current.
line.town.notice_swims.3: Look at that, swimming. And I keep meaning to.
line.town.notice_swims_cold.1: Have you lost your mind? The water's like ice! Get out!
line.town.notice_swims_cold.2: A winter swimmer, eh. Well, well. Hot tea afterwards, mind.
line.town.notice_swims_warm.1: Quite right! In this heat the water's the only place to be.
line.town.notice_sits.2: Fine view from here, isn't it? It's why I come.
line.town.notice_sits.3: Sit a while. Nobody's in a hurry here.
line.town.notice_sits.4: Just don't lean on that end, the board's loose.
line.town.notice_sits_known.1: Ah, it's you. Sit down, I've been keeping your place warm.
line.town.notice_sits_known.2: You again. Soon the bench will know us both.
line.town.date.1: We meet here every week. Same day, same hour.
line.town.date.2: Friends have to be seen on a schedule. Otherwise life always slips something in.
line.town.date.3: Late. Five minutes every time, like clockwork.
line.town.date.4: This is our spot. Taken for life, you might say.
line.town.date_talk3.1: Remember the first time we sat here?
line.town.date_talk3.2: I do. The bench was a different colour.
line.town.date_talk5.2: I'm listening to the sea. It's more interesting than me today.
line.town.date_kid.1: My friend and I meet here after school. It's our place, no grown-ups.
line.town.thunder.1: Good grief! That one was close.
line.town.thunder.2: One, two, three... A kilometre, no more.
line.town.thunder.3: Time to get under a roof. The sea doesn't like this.
line.town.thunder.4: I jump every time. Lived here for ages, and still I jump.
line.town.thunder_kid.1: Eek! ...I wasn't scared. I just did that.
line.town.thunder_kid.2: That's the sky moving its furniture!
line.town.counter1.2: This morning's. It came in still warm.
line.town.counter2.2: The usual's run out. There's almost-the-usual.
line.town.counter3.4: The same as the day before.
line.town.counter4.2: I have. The handles are weak, though, hold it from underneath.
line.town.counter5.1: What would you suggest with tea?
line.town.counter5.2: Gingerbread. Or company. With company even rusks will do.
line.town.counter6.1: Can you change a big note?
line.town.counter6.2: I can. In coins. All the coins I've got.
line.town.counter6.3: Then I'll look for something smaller.
line.town.counter_seller1.1: Shall I weigh it, or by eye?
line.town.counter_seller1.2: By eye. Your eye's truer than the scales.
line.town.counter_seller2.2: Some good weather, if you've got any.
line.town.counter_seller3.1: Haven't seen you in a while.
line.town.counter_seller3.2: Oh, I'm about, I just come at a different hour.
line.town.counter_seller3.3: Come at this one. It's fresher at this one.
line.town.counter_seller4.1: Take the cheese while it's here. It'll be gone by evening.
line.town.counter_market2.2: This morning's costs more; there's none of yesterday's.
line.town.counter_market3.1: Would you come down a little?
line.town.counter_market3.3: Well, throw in some dill at least.
line.town.counter_market4.1: Which meadow is this honey from?
line.town.counter_market4.2: The one past the upper station. The bees take the cable car up.
line.town.counter_kiosk1.2: I have. The news is yesterday's, mind.
line.town.counter_kiosk2.1: A postcard with the lighthouse, please.
line.town.counter_kiosk3.2: We keep no other kind. The sea's next door, it does the chilling.
line.town.counter_kid1.2: Let me count... Enough for one. A small one.
line.town.counter_kid2.1: Mum said: bread and the change.
line.town.counter_kid2.2: Here's the bread. And the change goes in your fist, and don't open it till you're home.
line.town.counter_elder1.1: There used to be a different counter here. A wooden one.
line.town.counter_elder1.2: It's still here. Under this one.
line.town.counter_elder2.1: Just a little for me. One person doesn't need much.
line.town.counter_elder2.2: I'll put in a bit extra. In case somebody drops by.
line.town.counter_rain1.1: Honestly, I'm in here out of the rain. But I'll buy something.
line.town.counter_rain1.2: Stay as you are. When it rains, half my shop is people like you.
line.town.counter_evening1.1: Am I in time? You haven't closed?
line.town.counter_evening1.2: I close when the last one leaves. You're not the last yet.
line.town.counter_evening2.2: All the best things. Kept back all day for you.
